name: How do comparable sales in my specific neighborhood help determine my FSBO listing price?

mainEntity.name: How do comparable sales in my specific neighborhood help determine my FSBO listing price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Comparable sales, or 'comps,' in your specific neighborhood are fundamental to determining your FSBO listing price because they reflect what buyers are currently willing to pay for similar homes. This involves analyzing properties that have recently sold (ideally within the last 3-6 months) in your immediate vicinity, focusing on features like size, number of bedrooms/bathrooms, lot size, condition, and amenities. For instance, a comp in Bay Harbor Islands directly informs your pricing more accurately than one from a different area, even within Miami-Dade. Ignoring these precise local sales can lead to significant pricing errors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Comparable sales in your specific neighborhood show what buyers are currently paying for similar homes. Analyzing these recent sales with matching features in your immediate area helps prevent significant pricing errors for your FSBO listing.
